heading: What the host adds
body:
The host adds three things. First, `data-platform="native"` on the document body. With it, a page can behave differently without checking the user agent string (the text that names the browser). Second, `tachyonWindow`. It carries the window controls that the manifest granted, and nothing else. Third, the service channel, which works in both directions.

On purpose, Tachyon adds no other capability vocabulary (a fixed list of platform actions). A compiled service can use its platform's SDK because it was compiled in that language for that target. A list of verbs between them would contain only the part that Tachyon had built.
